run_gen_gtest_pred_impl: run gen_gtest_pred_impl.py with a max arity argument to generate gtest predicate assertion header and unit test files
generate_header: generate the gtest_pred_impl.h header file with predicate assertion macros up to a given arity
generate_unittest: generate the gtest_pred_impl_unittest.cc unit test file with tests for predicate assertions up to a given arity
implementation_for_arity: generate the C++ implementation code for n-ary predicate assertion macros including helper functions and macro definitions
tests_for_arity: generate C++ unit test code for n-ary predicate assertions covering all combinations of function vs functor and built-in vs user-defined types
